reviews.summary: RLC faces a current exchange-access/liquidity risk: Phemex delisted RLC/USDT and closed RLC deposits/withdrawals on September 15, 2026. The supplied signal timestamp is future-dated (October 9 UTC) versus this audit date.
materialRisks: Phemex delisted the RLC/USDT spot pair on September 15, 2026 and disabled RLC deposits and withdrawals, creating venue-specific access and liquidity fragmentation risk.

facts.fact: Phemex’s official notice states RLC/USDT was delisted at 07:00 UTC on September 15, 2026; RLC deposits and withdrawals were no longer available after that time. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100380?utm_source=openai))

BloFin removed RLC from Spot Copy Trading on September 21–22, 2026, citing periodic review of liquidity, lead-trader activity, and user engagement; it stated this was not a platform-wide spot delisting. ([v3.blofin.com](https://v3.blofin.com/en/support/Announcement/Delisting/16118428649593-BloFin-Will-Delist-14-Spot-Copy-Trading-Pairs?utm_source=openai))

iExec states RLC has a fixed supply of about 86 million, with no unlocks and no inflation; no new unlock-driven supply event was identified in the reviewed official materials. ([iex.ec](https://iex.ec/blog/iexec-tokenomics-new-ways-to-use-earn-rlc?utm_source=openai))
